text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан's terrific performance awes
the crowd
and ignites the fighting spirit
of Хиши Амадзон,
who'd been watching
from the stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан wants even more strength.
To this
end, I recommend the Classic
Triple Crown tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Certain the path to growing stronger lies
in facing
strong opponents, we fix our
sights on the Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
